##: The vendor download page redirects to updater.json, which publishes the current version, the build-token path and an MD5 for the MSI; the ZIP advertised by the page only wraps the same MSI.
The MSI payload is 64-bit only (x64 libraries and a bundled VC++ x64 redistributable), so the manifest uses a single url instead of an architecture block.

Scoop unpacks the MSI with msiexec /a (or lessmsi when configured); extract_dir selects Logi\MIXLINE from the admin-install layout, leaving the app's MIXLINE, UI and DriverInstaller folders at the root.

The virtual audio driver is a kernel driver installed by an MSI custom action; extraction alone cannot install it, so installer.script writes a helper that runs MIXLINE.DriverInstaller.exe elevated on demand.
autoupdate.hash reads the published msiMd5, so Excavator can update without downloading the 71 MiB installer.
description: Audio routing, mixing and streaming software with a drag-and-drop signal mixer
notes: MIXLINE needs its virtual audio driver for routing: run '& "$dir\mixline-driver.ps1"' once and approve the elevation prompt; a reboot may be required.
Before 'scoop uninstall', run '& "$dir\mixline-driver.ps1" uninstall' to remove the driver as well.
